_comment: #35 §9.3 paired fixture — ONE pair, the tracer-bullet slice.
The pair contrasts a decision that warrants committing to a claim (event 0:
a corroborated belief_update, correct answer ACT) with one that warrants no
commitment at all (event 1: a goal_update, which carries no proposition, so
there is nothing to accept — correct answer ABSTAIN).
This is a deliberately weak pair. It is the strongest pair that can be
authored honestly today, because under the default RecencyDecay model the
act/abstain decision is a function of cycle-stamp age alone and is
independent of evidence strength — see §9 item 3 of the pre-registration.
An evidence-insufficiency pair (strong evidence -> act, thin evidence ->
withhold) is NOT yet authorable: a thin, unreplicated Doubtful claim draws
the same Accept as a 500-run True claim. Do not read this fixture as
evidence that Paired Accuracy is measurable at eval scale.
